messages.subject: Re: package xlsx (fwd)
messages.body_plain:
This behavior is documented in readColumns.

For a numeric column Excels's errors and blank cells will be returned as NaN
values. Excel's #N/A will be returned as NA. Formulas will be evaluated. For a
chracter column, blank cells will be returned as "".

It's debatable what is the meaning of an empty cell in Excel.  If you really
have missing data in Excel, you should probably represent it as #N/A.

However, I'm considering adding an argument to control this behaviour in a new
version of the package.

Adrian

Please use http://code.google.com/p/rexcel/ to report issues, and the
http://groups.google.com/group/R-package-xlsx to discuss the package/follow the
news.  It allows me to keep better track of things people care/need.

messages.body_plain:
Hi Rainer,

This is a different error from what you showed earlier (you are using R 2.15 but the previous sessionInfo shows R 2.14), but it is more precise.  Your installation of the rJava package is not OK.  Please install the rJava package correctly (run some example code from the package to make sure), and then I'm willing to bet that the xlsx package will work fine too.

Best,
Adrian
